name: adcopilot-x-ads
description: X Ads (Twitter Ads) help in your AI client, through AdCopilot. Today it checks your X Pixel in Google Tag Manager, reports X traffic and conversions in Google Analytics (GA4) by source, medium and campaign, finds UTM mistakes, guides conversion setup, plans campaigns, drafts promoted-post copy and does the budget pacing math. It does not read your X ad account. Every change is proposed first and made only on your yes. Made by Atromx Intelligence, not by X.
